
# Preamble {.unnumbered}

This book is a the policies and procedures manual for the [Association for Tropical Biology & Conservation](https://tropicalbiology.org/). It includes a checklist for new officers and committee chairs, guidelines on accessing, adding, and using the ATBC cloud storage drives, protocols for organizing meetings, and guides for administering ATBC finances. 


::: {.callout-tip}
## Citation

ATBC Council (Eds.). 2026. _ATBC Policies and Procedures Manual (v0.9.0)_. Zenodo. https://doi.org/-----

:::

--- 

This guide is a [Quarto Book](https://quarto.org/docs/books) hosted on the [ATBC Github site](https://github.com/-----). Any team member can edit the text, add new sections, or make suggestions for improvement either by [pull request](https://github.com/----/pulls) or by [posting an issue](https://github.com/-----/issues) on the ATBC Manual's repository. For more information and tutorials for doing so, see @sec-manual.
